evaluation_contract.source: WORKDOC_SIM_GRASP.original.md fixed acceptance; frozen before judged trials
evaluation_contract.pitch_status: Fixed by saved reachability before judged trials
evaluation_contract.force_epsilon_basis: Numerical contact activation floor, 0.068% of nominal cap weight. Counts force-bearing contacts, not zero-force margins.
evaluation_contract.numeric_tolerance_basis: Sub-mm contact softness at 1ms; tolerance is diagnostic numerical allowance, not relaxed task geometry. Any force-bearing forbidden pair is forbidden regardless of penetration.
evaluation_contract.hold_selection: First continuous >=2.0-second clearance-and-no-support interval inside declared hold phase. Evaluate bilateral duration and drift over first 2.0 seconds of it, with physics-step samples.
evaluation_contract.drift_reference: Cap center in grip frame at selected interval start; maximum Euclidean change across entire interval
evaluation_contract.cap_bottom: Finite cylinder support extent: center_z-halfheight*abs(axis_z)-radius*sqrt(1-axis_z^2), including tilt
whole_trial_rules: no solver warnings or iteration-budget exhaustion
strictly increasing time at declared timestep
no cap attachment or runtime pose mutation
